name: Mercury 3
short: Inception Labs' Oct 2026 flagship dLLM: non-autoregressive parallel decoding at >1,000 tok/s, 1M/128K at $0.10/$0.35 — GPQA 89.2%, MRCR 75.5%; text-only with tool/function calling and JSON mode.
pricingNote: Paid $0.10/$0.35 per 1M; prompt caching on host platforms
standout: Latency-critical agentic work: >1,000 tok/s with a verified 1M-token window at near-budget pricing.
tradeoff: Text-only and mid-tier on quality — diffusion drift shows up in deeply nested agent loops and coding sits below frontier models (SWE-bench 38.5%).
